_readme.what: Every line a player can read or hear read out, for web, Android and iOS. One file, one voice. Names and card lines of Hobs, Classes, shots and Doodads are not here: read those from the other content files.
_readme.keys: Join the path with dots: results.loss.title.kettle_pop. Keys are stable. Add keys, do not rename them.
_readme.placeholders: Curly braces round a plain word: {hob}, {rival}, {n}. Swap each one for its value. A line never holds a placeholder it does not need, and no line nests them.
_readme.pools: A list is a pool. Pick one line at random, and not the one you showed last time.
_readme.plurals: Where the count changes the words there are two keys, one and other. Use one when the count is 1.
_readme.ids: Sub-keys under how, why, by, state and notes are the ids the rules core sends. Look the id up as it comes.
_readme.notes: Keys that start with an underscore are notes for people. Do not show them.

levels._note: Level names, Rival names and Habits come from content/levels. This block adds the Notice, the Rival's key in rivals, and goal wording by Pennant type. If a level has no line for a Pennant type, use pennants.<type>, then the text in the level file.

1-1.notice: The lump known as Home Knoll is to be made level by teatime. Sorry for the mess.

goals.ground_kept: Leave the round hill its hump

1-2.notice: Hats above the permitted height have been seen on this hill. The hill will come down to match.

goals.bonk_nook: Bonk the Hob up the tower

1-3.notice: A kettle has been left on a knoll without a permit. Both are to be removed.
1-3.signature: Lance Corporal Fernsby, Parks and Verges

goals.kettle_pop: Pop the kettle by his wall

1-4.notice: There are three hills here. The schedule allows for none. Works begin when the wind drops.

1-5.notice: Works in this dell go on under a roof, to keep the forms dry. Please do not open it.

goals.bonk_with_knack: A Knack does the Bonking, under the roof

1-6.notice: Your roofs are over height. The Stamp Tower will see to them, one at a time.

goals.bonk_nook: Bonk the Hob atop the Stamp Tower

1-7.notice: One builder, found building, is held in the Cage on the middle hill. Collection is not advised.

1-8.notice: A sale of loose shells will be held between the orchards. The Sergeant will be taking the biggest.

goals.bonk_with_trick: A Trick Shell does the Bonking

1-9.notice: Loaf Hill spoils the view of High Hill. One of them has to go. We have picked Loaf.

1-10.notice: Keep off the lawn, the hedges and the roller. The hedges have been told to grow back.
1-10.signature: Marshal Mowbray Trimm, Parks and Verges

rivals._note: name is the name the level file carries. Find a Rival by levels.<id>.rival, or in Skirmish by matching name. short goes in banners and results. Taunts are pools: start once at the top of the fight, the rest now and then, never two turns running. Flatteners are polite and never gloat.

pudge.name: Sir Pudge

start: Is it today? Oh. Very well.
hit: There. May I sit down now?
miss: Wide. I shall try a bit closer.
hurt: I was resting on that wall.
unit_bonked: He will want a lie down. So do I.

sign_off: Lost. I shall sleep on it. Sir Pudge.

start: Reporting as told. Flattening starts at nine.
hit: Top floor first. It says so in the book.
miss: That one does not count, sir.
hurt: Not the hat. The hat is issued.
I shall have to write that down.

fernsby.name: Lance Corporal Fernsby

start: Kindly hold still. This is a survey.
hurt: My crew is further in. You will not find them.
kettle_hit: The kettle was meant to be there. Mostly.

sign_off: The kettle was where the plan put it. Lance Corporal Fernsby.

fernsby_acting.name: Corporal Fernsby

start: It is Corporal now. Mind the Cage.

sign_off: Cage returned, slightly bent. Corporal Fernsby (acting).

dibber.name: Corporal Dibber

hit: There. Got there in the end.
miss: Was that the wind? Nobody said.
hurt: I had only just raked that.
you_moved: Oh, you have moved. I shall start again.

sign_off: I am told there was wind. Corporal Dibber.
I had the range. Then you moved. Corporal Dibber.

rake.name: Sergeant Posy Rake

start: Line up, please. Smallest lump first.
rummage: The big one is mine. Thank you.

sign_off: Roof to be invoiced. Sergeant Rake.
I took the biggest shell. It did not help. Sergeant Rake.

snedd.name: Warden Snedd

start: I am a warden, not a soldier. Roofs off.
miss: I have hedges to do, you know.
hurt: Who do I see about this?

sign_off: Not my department anyway. Warden Snedd.

trimm.name: Marshal Mowbray Trimm

start: Marshal Trimm. Do keep off the lawn.
miss: The lawn forgives. I do not.
hurt: That was a peacock. It took nine years.
root_broke: That root was watering my hedges.

sign_off: Withdrawn in good order. The hedge will remember. Marshal Mowbray Trimm.

skirmish._note: Skirmish picks one of the named Rivals above by seed. This is the fallback if the app cannot.
skirmish.name: A Rival

start: You are on the list. Shall we?

banner._note: Now and then, in place of '{rival} aims'. One in four turns at most.

hobs._note: short is the name for chips, banners and spoken lines. Do not cut the content name at the first space: that gives Old and Miss.

marge.almanac: Marge Dumpling. Cooks. Fusses. Throws further than she lets on.

quill.almanac: Miss Quill. Mends hats. Cannot bear a crooked thing.

jax.almanac: Jax Pepper. Has a stall. Will sell you your own hat.

grub.almanac: Grub Mudgett. Digs. Has opinions about soil.

bobbin.almanac: Bobbin Springheel. Cobbler. Has not stood still since March.

hetty.almanac: Hetty Mortarboard. Builds. Is marking you as we speak.

old_thumper.almanac: Old Thumper. Sixty years of throwing things at hedges.

hedge_snipper.almanac: Hedger. Clips first, then says sorry.

mower_minder.almanac: Mower. Goes up and down. Mostly down.

pebble_pitcher.almanac: Pitcher. Picks out the stones. Sends them back.

straw_stuffer.almanac: Dummy. Stands there. Does it well.

results._note: Win in a campaign level: the title is levels.<id>.win_title and win.how.<how> sits under it, then one line from the Rival's sign_off. Any other win: the title is win.title.<how>. Loss: loss.title.<how>, then loss.cause.<how> if it is not empty, then one Hetty line from loss.verdict. Never show a cause line that says the same as the title.

how.clean_sweep: Clean Sweep. Every one of them Bonked.
how.squall: Blown Out. The Squall got their kettle first.
how.double_pop: Both kettles went. You had more left.
how.rescue: Out of the Cage, hat and all.
how.round_cap: Out of rounds. You had more left standing.
how.total_hp: Out of rounds. You had more left standing.
how.volley_points: Out of shots. You scored more.
how.captive_bonked: That was their shot, so it is your win.

cause.clean_sweep: They got everyone. {hob} went last, Round {n}.
cause.double_pop: Both kettles went in the same Squall round. They had more left.
cause.volley_points: Out of shots. They scored more.

verdict._note: One line from Hetty, the builder. Pick the pool by the last blow's by id if there is a pool for it (ground, fatigue, self, shears), else by how. Before 1-7 is cleared, show the line with no name on it.
kettle_pop: Kettle was one block from the wall.
One wall round a kettle is a curtain.
They knew where it was. Move it.
Put the kettle further in. I did say.
clean_sweep: Two Hobs on the top floor. Brave.
Everyone by the window. Lovely view.
A Nook wants four walls. Count them.
squall: Nothing wrong with the fort. It rained shells.
round_cap: Still standing. Just less of it.
They chipped. You admired the view.
total_hp: Still standing. Just less of it.
volley_points: Aim at Hobs. Walls score less.
rescue: I was in the Cage. I counted the rounds.
Bars first next time. Then their fort.
captive_bonked: Aim at the bars. Not at me.
give_up: I'd have had one more go.
We'll say it was the wind.
ground: It fell on its own. That's on the builder.
fatigue: It creaked. Then it stopped creaking.
Cracked blocks let go. Mend them sooner.
self: That one was yours. I watched.
shears: The shears cut on the red line. It says so.

results.double_pop_rule: Both kettles went in the same Squall round. Whoever had more left standing before it wins.

errors._note: Plain, and each one says what is safe. No jokes here.
errors.fatal_body: The game stopped and could not carry on. Your progress is saved after every turn.
errors.load_body: Check your connection and try again. Once it has loaded one time, it also plays offline.
errors.start_body: Your save may be damaged. Try again, or reset the save to start fresh.
errors.not_installed: The game did not install properly. Please install it again.
errors.fight_stuck_body: Try again to pick it up from the last saved turn.
errors.fight_cannot_start: This fight could not start. Nothing is lost.
errors.fight_broke: This fight broke and had to stop. Your progress is safe.
errors.fight_broke_saved: This fight broke. Your last save is kept. Press Carry on to try from there.
errors.move_failed: That did not go through. Nothing is lost. Try again.
errors.turn_reset: Something slipped. Back to the start of your turn.
errors.give_up_failed: The fight could not be ended. It goes on.
errors.save_last_unreadable: Your last save could not be read, so the one before it was loaded.
errors.save_unreadable: Your save could not be read. It was kept to one side and a fresh one started.
errors.saved_fight_damaged: This saved fight is damaged and was put aside. Your progress is safe.
errors.saved_fight_old: The game rules changed since this fight was saved, so it cannot be carried on. Your progress and Pennants are safe.
errors.saved_fight_differs: This saved fight replayed a little differently from when it was saved.
errors.saved_fight_cleared: Your saved fight could not be loaded, so it was cleared. Your progress is safe.
errors.no_saved_fight: There is no fight to carry on.
errors.fort_did_not_fit: Your Workshop fort did not fit this fight, so the level's fort was used.
